Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells

Benefit: Whenever you cast an enhancing spell of 3rd level or higher, you can spend an immediate action to gain temporary HP equal to 10% of your maximum HP, +1 additional temporary hit point per level of the highest-level enhancing spell you can cast. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute and stack with other sources of temporary hit points. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting enhancing spells.
